programme.title: The Brothers O'Toole

programme.desc: A California girl called Gidget (Sandra Dee) spends summer with surf bums called Moondoggie (James Darren) and Kahuna (Cliff Robertson).
programme.title: Gidget

programme.desc: A fashion photographer (Fred Astaire) turns a Greenwich Village bookworm (Audrey Hepburn) into a Paris cover girl.
programme.title: Funny Face

programme.desc: A Polish Jew (Alan Arkin), a Russian officer (Rutger Hauer) and a seamstress (Joanna Pacula) lead a 1943 mass escape from a Nazi death camp.
programme.title: Escape From Sobibor

programme.desc: Two detective-school graduates (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) help a framed boxer who can make himself disappear.
programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Invisible Man

programme.desc: A Scotland Yard detective (Joseph Cotten) figures out why a schizoid Victorian (Charles Boyer) is trying to drive his wife (Ingrid Bergman) mad.
programme.title: Gaslight

programme.desc: Doc Holliday (Kirk Douglas) joins Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and his brothers for a Tombstone showdown with the Clanton gang.
programme.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral

programme.desc: New York playgirl Holly Golightly puzzles a writer who lives in her building.
programme.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's

programme.desc: A suave angel (Cary Grant) saves a woman (Loretta Young) and her Episcopal husband (David Niven) from spiritual doubt and marital woe.
programme.title: The Bishop's Wife

programme.desc: An ace reporter's editor, her ex-husband, tries everything possible to stop her from remarrying someone else.
programme.title: His Girl Friday

programme.desc: A detective (Peter O'Toole) helps a French art forger's daughter (Audrey Hepburn) steal a fake Venus.
programme.title: How to Steal a Million

programme.title: To Kill a Mockingbird

programme.title: Road to Bali

programme.title: Firewalker

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon

programme.desc: A Virginia militia captain (Gary Cooper) rivals a Colonial trader (Howard da Silva) for an indentured Englishwoman (Paulette Goddard) around Indians.

programme.title: Man With a Camera

programme.title: Bonanza

programme.title: Bye Bye Birdie
